description: Java class 'DocumentCommandValidator' for validating document commands in the Fineract project, including methods for validation during create and update operations.

classes.name: DocumentCommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class for DocumentCommand objects, providing validation logic for create and update operations.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
